newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: New bat, deadly frog discovered in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: New bat, deadly frog discovered in Colombia.

text.p: Scientists in northwest Colombia have discovered a new species of bat as well as a type of frog that packs enough poison to kill hundreds of people, a conservation group said on Tuesday.

The deadly frog, Phillobates Terribilis, exists in other parts of the world but had never been found in Colombia. A few drops of its poison can kill up to 1,500 people, spokesmen for the regional environmental group CORNARE said in a telephone interview from Rionegro, a suburb of the northwest city of Medellin.
The bat, Saccopterix Atioquegnesis, is not found anywhere else in the world, CORNARE said in a news release.
CORNARE sponsored a six-month field study in the east of Antioquia province by a team of independent scientists who also discovered three other new species of frogs and a lizard.
"The discovery of this new species of bat is of transcendental importance given that it is very rare to find a new mammal anywhere in the world," a CORNARE spokesman said.
